item.title: Antonio Delgado ends campaign for NY governor
item.description: Lieutenant Governor Antonio Delgado has suspended his campaign for New York Governor. He made the announcement on Tuesday.

item.title: Hewerton Moreira out as UCFC head coach
item.description: Utica City FC have announced that they are "parting ways" with head coach Hewerton Moreira after four seasons behind the bench.

item.title: Valentine's Day alert: Romance scams on the rise in NYS
item.description: With Valentine's Day fast approaching, the New York State Division of Consumer Protection is warning New Yorkers about romance scams.

item.title: ASAP Act targets faster solar energy growth, $1 billion annual savings
item.description: New York lawmakers and advocates are pushing for the ASAP Act, which would double the state's solar energy goals and save residents up to $1 billion a year, but faces opposition from Republicans over safety concerns and local farmland loss.

item.title: Oneonta Police searching for missing vulnerable Oneonta woman
item.description: The Oneonta Police Department is asking for the public's help in locating a missing Oneonta woman.

item.title: New York State Senate passes environmental package to counter federal rollbacks
item.description: The New York State Senate Democratic Majority advanced nine bills to reduce industrial pollution, remove toxic chemicals from consumer goods, and increase corporate transparency, in response to environmental deregulation under the Trump administration.

item.title: Village of Poland to decide on dissolution of fire district
item.description: On Tuesday, members of the Poland Joint Fire District -- which covers several towns and villages in the area -- will vote on whether or not to keep the district going.
